title: MapleStory Classic Beginner's First Steps
author: Nia Meow
summary: A first-hours route from Maple Island to the level 10 job choice, including beginner quests, safe AP allocation, early travel, and survival priorities.

sections.title: Maple Island route
items: Talk to every NPC and complete the beginner quest chains.
Leave for Lith Harbor after the island route is complete.

sections.title: Ability points
items: Use the primary-stat and secondary-stat split for the job you intend to choose.
Job advancement does not automatically repair incorrectly allocated AP.

sections.title: Level 10 transition
items: Travel to the correct town and instructor for your first job.
Move into the dedicated class and grinding guides for levels 10-30.

notes: Original MPStorys structured summary based on the exact specialist guide, verified in Chrome on 2026-07-27.
prerequisites: A new MapleStory Classic World character
steps: Allocate AP for the intended class.
Travel to the correct first-job instructor.
Continue with the matching level 10-30 class route.
